title: Integrations
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://dev.dengage.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

Connect Dengage to the tools your team already uses. Go to **Settings → Integrations** in the Dengage panel to manage every integration in one place.

## What you can do here   [Skip link to What you can do here](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/settings-integrations\#what-you-can-do-here)

- **[Applications](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/applications)**: Register the websites and mobile apps (Web, iOS, Android, Custom Inbox) that connect to Dengage through the SDK.
- **[Image Hosting](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/image-hosting)**: Upload campaign images once and reuse them in any channel.
- **[3rd Party Integration](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration)**: Connect tools such as Shopify, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Mixpanel, and WhatsApp. Some connectors need activation by your customer success manager first.
- **[Remote Sources](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/remote-sources)**: Import data from your own databases, such as MySQL or Google BigQuery.
- **[Remote Targets](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/remote-targets)**: Export contacts, events, or campaign results to external systems, such as AWS S3, Salesforce, or Facebook Custom Audience.

Each page above walks you through setup step by step.

> 📘
>
> ### **Key terms**   [Skip link to [object Object]](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/settings-integrations\#key-terms)
>
> - **Remote Source**: an external database that Dengage reads data from.
> - **Remote Target**: an external system that Dengage sends data to.
> - **Segment**: a group of contacts that match rules you define, such as "customers who bought in the last 30 days."
> - **Remote query execution**: Dengage runs your query directly on the external database and uses live results, without copying data into Dengage first.

## Choose the right integration   [Skip link to Choose the right integration](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/settings-integrations\#choose-the-right-integration)

- To bring customer data **into** Dengage, use a [Remote Source](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/remote-sources). For example, build a segment of customers who abandoned a cart yesterday.
- To send data **out** of Dengage, use a [Remote Target](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/remote-targets). For example, push a segment to Facebook Custom Audiences for ad retargeting.
- To sync with a specific platform, check the catalog in [3rd Party Integration](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration).
